svg.text: DICTO scutoid group — the two flat cuts (and the middle)
Same number = same piece. Gold = pentagon, blue = hexagon. Red dot = corner where 4 pieces meet (the scutoid’s Y lies exactly on the cut).
Bold = one group of 8 pieces; faint = neighbouring groups (the same group repeated). Pieces 1–4: pentagon on top, hexagon below; 5–8 the other way round.
